role_label_detection.rationale: The plain English words 'verify', 'represent' and 'compare' are perfectly good learner copy; what must never appear is the machine label. Detection therefore matches an ALL-CAPS token or a heading that is exactly the label, never the lowercase word inside a sentence.

rule: Internal semantics may remain technical. Learner pages must use only approved public labels or ordinary mathematical language.
extension_note: forbidden_learner_role_labels, internal_role_label_public_titles, internal_identifier_patterns and role_label_detection were added by M-UPGRADE-2 item 9. The original forbidden_learner_terms list, the approved labels and policy_id are unchanged, so the binding check in LearnerProduct/engine/run_learner_product.py still resolves. The addition closes the one gap the original list left open: an internal *role* label (RECONSTRUCT, CONTRAST, VERIFY) printed as a learner heading is the same defect class as pipeline jargon, and was not matched by a substring ban-list. The executable detector is Mathematics/LearnerRealization/engine/learner_copy.py, which reads this file as its authority.
